name: doodad-fix-on-load
description: p6 item 9: 212 doodads (200 of doodad-save-rules + 12 odd angles, scale ranges, off-grid pathing); expected to differ: 6 doodads with a zero scale get a random one in both (the editor's differs from Studio's); Studio fixes and snaps them on load, then saves; the World Editor does the same on its own load

steps.eval: const s = await w3.services.get('w3.terrain'); for (let i = 0; i < 60 && !s.placedObjects()?.doodads?.length; i++) await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 500)); window.__driveEd.pushEdit({ undo() {}, redo() {}, terrain: false, objects: false });
